# Command-line reference

Every command and option of *hxex*, from the program's own definitions (`hxex COMMAND --help` prints the same). [The project file and the commands](project-file.md) shows how they fit together.

Messages and progress go to the terminal's error stream, results and summaries to its output. Ctrl-C stops a run cleanly after the current step (a second Ctrl-C aborts at once). Exit status: 0 done, 1 an error (its message is printed), 2 a usage error, 130 stopped.

A short path on the command line (`--bundle`, `--out`, `--tables DIR`, ...) is counted from the folder the terminal is in; one in the project file (`[output] bundle`, ...) from the folder that holds the project file ([File and folder locations](project-file.md#file-and-folder-locations)).

## Options of every command

Given before the command: `hxex -v run hxex.toml`.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--version` | show hxex's version, with the commit it was installed from |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | warnings and errors only |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | more messages |
| `--progress-every` `SECONDS` | seconds between progress lines (default 30) |

## hxex init

Write a project file with every default.

`hxex init [options]`

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--format` `{specexport,hxexpress,pooled,mzml,thermo}` | the input format (default specexport) |
| `--project` `PROJECT` | the project name |
| `-o`, `--output` `OUTPUT` | the file to write (default hxex.toml; '-' for stdout) |
| `--force` | replace an existing file (without it, init refuses to write over one) |

## hxex set

Change one setting of a project file (no text editor needed).

`hxex set hxex.toml SETTING VALUE [options]`

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `hxex.toml` | the project file (hxex.toml, written by hxex init) |
| `SETTING` | the setting as table.name, e.g. run.controls.d2o_fraction (the settings page of the guide lists them) |
| `VALUE` | its new value: a number, true or false, text (no quotes needed: 20 min, controls), or a list in quotes ("[1, 2]") |
| `--default` | switch the setting off again (a # in front), so that it takes its default; give no value |

## hxex check

Check a project file and show what would be read.

`hxex check hxex.toml [options]`

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `hxex.toml` | the project file (hxex.toml, written by hxex init) |
| `--spectra` `PATH` | take the raw spectra stored in this bundle (or spectra file) instead of reading the input (as input.spectra) |

## hxex run

Run a project: read, pick, fit, bootstrap, write the bundle and tables (figures: hxex report).

`hxex run hxex.toml [options]`

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `hxex.toml` | the project file (hxex.toml, written by hxex init) |
| `--bundle` `BUNDLE` | the results bundle (instead of output.bundle; relative to the current folder, not to the project file's) |
| `--overwrite` | replace an existing bundle (and its tables), carrying its review over; also a tables folder left from a bundle that is gone |
| `--keep-previous` | move an existing bundle (with its tables, figures and analysis folders) to the next generation, NAME.N, before writing |
| `--device` `DEVICE` | cpu, cuda, cuda:1, ... (instead of run.fit.backend) |
| `--spectra` `PATH` | take the raw spectra stored in this bundle (or spectra file) instead of reading the input (as input.spectra) |
| `--threads` `N` | CPU threads (default: the project file's threads, else PyTorch's) |

## hxex resume

Complete a bundle's bootstrap (finish a stopped one, add or redo one, or bootstrap the review's chosen K), or add the population test.

`hxex resume hxex.toml|BUNDLE [options]`

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `hxex.toml\|BUNDLE` | the project file (hxex.toml), or a results bundle (a folder, or .zip) waiting for its bootstrap. With the project file, its [output] bundle gets a bootstrap with its [run.bootstrap] settings (redone only if they changed), one at the K its [review] table chooses where that is missing, and the population test with its [run.population_test] settings (made again only if they changed); the fits kept |
| `--device` `DEVICE` | cpu, cuda, cuda:1, ... (instead of the run's device) |
| `--threads` `N` | CPU threads (default: the project file's threads, else PyTorch's) |
| `--tables` `[DIR]` | where the tables go (default: beside the bundle, or a project file's [output] tables) |

## hxex report

Write the tables again (with the review applied), and with --figures draw the figures, from the results; fits nothing.

`hxex report hxex.toml|BUNDLE [options]`

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `hxex.toml\|BUNDLE` | the project file (hxex.toml): its [output] bundle, with its [review] decisions applied and its [figures] settings; or a results bundle (a folder, or .zip) |
| `--threads` `N` | CPU threads (default: the project file's threads, else PyTorch's) |
| `--tables` `[DIR]` | where the tables go (default: beside the bundle, NAME_tables, or the project file's [output] tables); they are always written, and with [output] tables = false only when --tables is given |
| `--figures` `[DIR]` | also draw the figures (default: beside the bundle, NAME_figures) |
| `--overwrite` | replace hxex's files in the tables and figures folders when they hold earlier output (or [output] overwrite = true) |
| `--keep-previous` | move the tables and figures folders to NAME.N first when they hold earlier output (or [output] keep_previous = true) |
| `--series` `{flagged,all}` | which series to draw (default: [figures] series, else flagged) |
| `--k` `K` | draw every series at this number of populations (default: [figures] k, else each spectrum's own) |
| `--format` `{pdf,png,svg}` | figure file format |

## hxex analyse

The post-fitting analysis of a bundle: tables and figures.

`hxex analyse hxex.toml|BUNDLE ... [options]`

Also spelt `hxex analyze`.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `hxex.toml\|BUNDLE ...` | the project file, hxex.toml (its [analysis] settings, and [analysis.runs] or output.bundle; a file with only [analysis] is enough), a bundle, or several bundles to compare as separate runs (NAME=BUNDLE, or BUNDLE named after its file; the tables get a run column) |
| `--bundle` `BUNDLE` | the bundle (instead of the project's output.bundle; relative to the current folder, not to the project file's) |
| `--out` `OUT` | the output directory (default: [analysis] out, else the bundle's name + _analysis + _REFERENCE when there is a reference, e.g. results_analysis_WT) |
| `--overwrite` | replace hxex's files in the analysis folder when it holds earlier output (or [output] overwrite = true) |
| `--keep-previous` | move the analysis folder to NAME.N first when it holds earlier output (or [output] keep_previous = true) |
| `--reference` `REFERENCE` | the reference sample (instead of [analysis] reference; `RUN:sample` when the sample is in several runs) |
| `--format` `{pdf,png,svg}` | figure file format |
| `--threads` `N` | CPU threads (default: the project file's threads, else PyTorch's) |

## hxex info

What the results hold.

`hxex info hxex.toml|BUNDLE [options]`

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `hxex.toml\|BUNDLE` | the project file (hxex.toml): its [output] bundle, and what its [review] table decides; or a results bundle (a folder, or .zip) |
| `--verify` | also check every file's checksum |
